title: Depth of Early ED Hypotension and Acute Kidney Injury: analysis code
description: Analysis code and non-identifiable aggregate outputs for a target-trial-style study of early emergency department hypotension depth and 7-day acute kidney injury or death in MIMIC-IV-ED linked to MIMIC-IV. Patient-level data are not included and cannot be redistributed under the PhysioNet data use agreement.
